_desc: OPTIONAL /setup page (enable in config.json) — step-by-step editor setup guide (numbered steps, kbd chips, download buttons, collapsible code panels with copy buttons) + its home 'Development' card.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle. Reference: 'Complete guide to setting up VSCode / Cursor with my settings.'
_fields.homeCardDescription: One-liner on the home card. Reference: 'VSCode / Cursor configuration and extensions guide.'
_fields.editors: Editor names the guide targets. Reference: ['VS Code', 'Cursor'].
_fields.downloads: Download buttons: [{ label, file }] — put the actual files in content/images/setup/ (served from /images/setup/) or provide them and I'll place them.
_fields.settingsFile: Path to your editor settings JSON shown in the collapsible 'Show' panel. Example: 'content/setup-settings.json' (any text file path works).
_fields.steps: Leave [] to use the reference flow (download files -> install extensions via command palette -> paste settings -> done). Or define custom steps: [{ title, substeps: [{ text, kbd, code, downloadRef }] }].
